an4.97:2.2: This passage clarifies the sense of the common phrase, “one who practices in line with the teaching” (_dhammānudhammappaṭipanna_). The _dhamma_ here is specifically the “teaching” (rather than “principle” or “moral law”). In fact, though the compound masks the number, it should probably be plural (“teachings”). When at [snp1.3:35.2]() the compound is resolved, the initial element is locative plural (_dhammesu_) suggesting the literal rendering, “one who, in respect of the teachings, practices according to the teachings”.
